total_lines = int(input().strip())
data = input().strip()

max_len = 0
token_count = 0
current_index = 0
last_index = 0

while current_index < data.rfind(')'):
    open_paren = data.find('(', current_index)
    close_paren = data.find(')', open_paren)
    segment = data[last_index:open_paren]
    for token in segment.split('_'):
        if len(token) > max_len:
            max_len = len(token)
    inside = data[open_paren + 1:close_paren]
    for token in inside.split('_'):
        if token != '':
            token_count += 1
    last_index = close_paren + 1
    current_index = close_paren

tail = data[last_index:]
for token in tail.split('_'):
    if len(token) > max_len:
        max_len = len(token)

print(f"{max_len} {token_count}")
